subject: medkit
label: medkit.mdl, in the place of the game's models/w_medkit.mdl

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_crowbar.mdl, models/w_shotgun.mdl, models/snapbug.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: Flat rectangular slab, 35 by 26 by 7, matching the brief's lying-flat case. Front, left, back and right views show the same low outline, with the handle rising a little above the top. No part sticks out or is missing.

M2.reason: Measured 35 x 26 x 7 against the brief's 35 long, 26 wide, 7 high, so sizeOff is 0 on all three.

M3.reason: Brief's parts: white case (present, one slab), red cross (painted on top, clear plus shape with arms of even length, reads at the view's size), carry handle (black straight bar along the right edge of the top, with small end posts visible in the front and back views). Brief names no other parts, and none is missing.

M4.reason: Case is a light grey-white, which reads as the brief's white; cross is clearly red; handle is black. Each region is one material and colour, with no stray colour on the body.

M5.reason: The brief asks for a little scuffing. The top and edges carry speckled mottling and lighter chipped edges along the rim, in the places a handled case would wear. The red cross is sharp and the handle's edges read. The wear is there and not overdone.

M6.reason: The shape and colours pass as a first aid pickup, but the lineup holds no Half-Life medkit to pit it against, so a player's pick cannot be confirmed. Beside the crowbar, shotgun and snapbug it is the only object of its kind, and its clean surface shows little of the scuffing the brief asks for.

M7.reason: Lies flat on its base, upright and level in the side views; the bottom sits on the origin plane. The brief gives no front, so nothing is turned the wrong way.

M8.reason: SMAK checkErrors is empty. 72 triangles is under the Half-Life median of 99 and under the three-quarters line of 156. The views show a closed solid with no open faces, inverted faces or floating parts.
